reuse.why: All month-wide consumers share getMonthWideCategories and reuse existing tag parsing, spreadsheet access, budget writes, batching, and undo wrappers.

duplication.why: The repeated category-selection queries are consolidated, although the new action repeats the existing income eligibility guard.

placement.why: Category eligibility and spending calculations remain in budget/actions.ts, with handler registration in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared selector makes exclusion changes straightforward, although income eligibility remains distributed and its return type promises an unselected group_hidden field.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions use getMonthWideCategories, and the new action uses the existing persistence and undo abstractions.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining repeated income eligibility guard is explicit rather than disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories boolean and one conditional hidden-filter branch; all six month-wide consumers continue using it.
